name: beUI
summary: Copy-paste animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, distributed through the shadcn registry.
description: Free, open-source animated components for React and Next.js: motion primitives, AI agent interfaces, blocks and charts, built on Motion (Framer Motion) and styled with shadcn semantic tokens. Copy the TypeScript source or install with the shadcn CLI from its registry (124 items); a paid Pro tier adds premium blocks and components.
contains: 140 components plus blocks, agents and charts categories
free open-source components; Pro adds 292+ blocks and premium components ($149 lifetime)
built on Motion (Framer Motion) with Tailwind 4 and React 19
shadcn token theming; registry JSON endpoints at /r and /r/{slug}/raw
AI agent components: prompt input, messages, streaming response, tool results, citations
